mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 4.5% signals a weak labor market, which is associated with reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO and HOUST both exceed their 12-month moving averages, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth > 2.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO rises month-over-month, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST below 1500 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS and INDPRO both exceed their 12-month moving averages, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of weak consumer demand (defined as RSAFS below its 12-month moving average and HOUST below its 12-month moving average), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, producing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both fall below their 12-month moving averages, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
